sentences.text:
M/S Samco Associates And Builders And 2 ... vs State Of U.P.
And 3 Others on 7 November, 2023
Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta

Bench: Manoj Kumar Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner :- M/S Samco Associates And Builders And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Vivek Saran
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus restraining the respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from Khasra No. 751, Village Baral Partapur, Tehsil Sadar, District Meerut till disposal of the application dated 26.7.2023.
2.
Part of Khasra No. 751 was acquired under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: An award for the acquired land was made on 16.6.2023.

The petitioner has filed an application on 26.7.2023 M/S Samco Associates And Builders And 2 ... vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 7 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123183988/
1 requesting the respondents to acquire his entire land as no access to the remaining land is left after acquisition of part of Khasra No. 751.
3.

entities.text: M/S Samco Associates And Builders And 2 ... vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners at the time of making oral submissions, submits that the petitioners would feel satisfied in case a direction is issued to the respondents to consider their representation dated 26.7.2023, having regard to the difficulty being faced by the petitioners on account of there being no access to the remaining land.
4. Sri Rajeev Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has no objection to the same.

5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with direction to respondent no. 3 to consider the representation dated 26.7.2023 in accordance with law within a period of eight weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with photocopy of the representation.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 7.11.2023
